relations.relation: locate text spans asserting a causal relationship or extrapolation beyond observed data
identify the study design or data cited as support for each located claim
compare asserted claim strength against identified evidence strength to flag over- or under-statement
locate text spans asserting transferability or generalizability to a different population or context
identify evidence bearing on similarity between the studied context and the context to which the claim generalizes
locate text spans asserting a causal effect, mechanism, or extrapolation beyond the studied context
locate text spans describing the study design, sample, or population that a nearby claim relies on
pair each claim span to its supporting design descriptor and characterize whether the claim's asserted strength matches what the design can support
pair a claim's stated generalization scope to the design descriptor's actual sampled population or context to flag overreach or underreach
detect hedging or certainty language attached to a claim span and check its consistency with the claim-design strength pairing
text span asserting a causal (not merely correlational) relationship between two or more variables
study design or data source cited in support of a given causal claim (e.g., experimental, quasi-experimental, observational, correlational)
comparison of the asserted certainty/strength of a causal claim against the certainty warranted by its cited evidence type
text span asserting that a finding applies beyond the population, context, or conditions actually studied
description of the sample, setting, or population actually examined, against which external-validity/transferability claims are checked

metric.name: Causal inference and generalization claims rigor
metric.text: Sound handling of causal claims and extrapolation, careful calibration of claims to evidence, and accurate statements about external validity/transferability.
